We're always excited to connect with experienced Senior Product Managers who are passionate about creating exceptional mobile game experiences. If you thrive at the intersection of creativity, strategy, and data, we'd love to hear you are interested in future opportunities at Outfit7.

If you are someone who:

• Has 5+ years of experience in product management or game production roles in mobile games.
• Has successfully launched mobile games and understands the F2P business model.
• Uses player insights, analytics, and market trends to make confident product decisions.
• Enjoys collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to turn ideas into engaging game experiences.
• Can balance business goals, creativity, and player experience throughout the product lifecycle.
• Is passionate about mobile games and driven to build products that millions of players love.

We encourage you to join our talent pool and be among the first to be considered when an opportunity arises.

Apply today and stay connected with us!
